_readme: App profile for scripts/scope-checklist.py. Corresponds to Scenario B in
labs/lab-01-build-the-checklist.md: a consumer retail banking app, public Play
distribution, public API, with two named incidents in the last year.
Note the field that does the most work in this file:
in scope because hostile_device_owner is true, and it will QUOTE THE NAMED ADVERSARY
in the justification. If you set hostile_device_owner true and leave the adversary
null, the script warns you -- because resilience recommended without a named
adversary is the most expensive bad advice in mobile security.
name: Regional Bank Mobile
standard_version: MASVS v2.x -- resolve and record the exact version at mas.owasp.org

threat_model.hostile_device_owner_adversary: fraud rings automating onboarding from emulator farms, and account-takeover actors following SIM-swap
